prerequisites: Basic knowledge of Excel Word Power Point
basic knowledge of energy sources and equipment (definition of efficiency, fuel consumption, etc.)
syllabus_topics: The methodology and the importance of the energy audit.
Application of the Law on energy management, rational energy use in the municipal sector and in industry.
Basic legislation related to energy and environmental protection of the affected energy resources.
Sustainable development in terms of energy.
Design, processing, evaluation and presentation of a simple energy audit for selected energy source or consumer.
degree: Oferta Erasmus+ en inglés de la Fac. de Ingeniería Mecánica (sin plan de grado atado)
